# Project Guidelines

## Issue Handling

When assigned a GitHub issue, check whether it is requesting information from **Microsoft Learn documentation** (e.g., Azure docs, .NET docs, Microsoft API references, code samples from Microsoft official docs).

If the issue is about Microsoft Learn content, delegate to the `microsoft-learn` agent to research and resolve it. Do not attempt to answer Microsoft documentation questions from your training data alone — always use the agent so it can fetch the latest official content.
